definitions: A general term for edible plant produce, typically sweet or savoury, that are commonly consumed as part of a healthy diet.
The collective category of fresh produce from plants, including items like apples, bananas, carrots, and broccoli, often sold together in shops.
examples: Eating plenty of fruit and vegetables is good for you.
The supermarket has a wide selection of fruit and vegetables.
She always includes fruit and vegetables in her meals.
